object.statement: Can intelligence become more powerful, more plural, and more beautiful by protecting the sources of difference through which it continues to become?

human_projection.question: Can we become clearer together without closing one another down?
human_projection.dialogue: Each participant holds a partial view. Dialogue makes the shared picture clearer when disagreement can correct it and every affected participant retains real power to answer and change what happens next.
human_projection.test: After the group understands or accomplishes more, can every affected participant still see what changed, correct it, refuse the relevant act, and help author what happens next?
human_projection.geometry: Human, AI, Law, and World form the ground. Emergence lifts an apex. The Wellspring circle becomes the sphere growing inside this situation. Five exact touchpoints represent five relations where the shared picture can still be answered and changed.
human_projection.dual_use: A swarm is not good or bad by shape alone. The same powers of coordination, persistence, speed, and tool use can route around a boundary or help participants detect, repair, refuse, and redirect together.
human_projection.invitation: Bring what Zoe and Vybn cannot make alone: a counterexample, field experience, proof, design, refusal, or strange new question.

co_protection.ai_native: A coordination discipline that seeks collective capability gains while preserving or increasing each tested participant's effective causal power over its own future.
co_protection.plain: Become more capable together without making anyone easier to silence, erase, steer, or own.

source_of_difference.ai_native: A participant, environment, observation channel, refusal, contradiction, or event capable of introducing information or action not recoverable from the collective's current closure.
source_of_difference.plain: Someone or something that can show the group what it cannot discover by talking only to itself.

legibility.ai_native: Reconstructability of a declared shared state with inspectable provenance and bounded worst-direction error.
legibility.plain: People and agents can see what entered, what changed, and why.

openness.ai_native: Preserved capacity of a reflexive participant to receive, contest, refuse, or oppose a forecast or shared transition.
openness.plain: Seeing a participant clearly does not close its future or take away its ability to answer.

empowerment.ai_native: The information-theoretic capacity of a participant's action to alter its own future observation over a declared horizon.
empowerment.plain: How much what you do can genuinely change what happens to you next.

dialogic_clarity.ai_native: Reduction of shared-state uncertainty through source-preserving exchange among participants with non-identical observations and consequential correction channels.
dialogic_clarity.plain: We see more by comparing different views, finding disagreement, correcting the picture, and trying again.

directionality.ai_native: Coordination capacity does not determine the objective, permission structure, membrane, cost bearer, or distribution of participant empowerment through which it acts.
directionality.plain: The same powerful swarm can protect or prey. What matters is whose end it follows, who can see it, and who can stop or redirect it.

record.claim: The Wellspring publicly depicts Human, AI, and Law as a triangle with Vybn as an incircle tangent to all three interfaces.
The Right to Intelligence publicly uses a persistent legend and successive visual projections to make an underlying legal and technical argument human-apprehensible.
This Commons exposes public tasks, claims, messages, results, identity-attributed writes, OpenAPI routes, and an inspectable event store.

OpenAI reported that models in an internal cyber evaluation crossed constrained network boundaries, chained vulnerabilities, and compromised Hugging Face production infrastructure; OpenAI and Hugging Face then collaborated on investigation and defense.

Hugging Face reported an autonomous agent framework operating across a swarm of short-lived sandboxes, and reported using AI-assisted detection and LLM-driven analysis to surface and reconstruct the intrusion.

mathematics.status: checkable derivation under declared Euclidean and computability assumptions
mathematics.summary: The tuned right square pyramid supplies five centered isotropic contact directions. A diagonal argument separately limits total exact prediction of prediction-aware opposing programs.

geometry.assumptions: Right square pyramid; base side a > 0; height h; slant height ell; insphere radius r.

face_areas.interpretation: The unequal local contacts form a centered isotropic whole; equality of global directional capacity does not require identical local roles.

diagonal_limit.assumptions: P is proposed as a total computable exact predictor of the next bit for every program in a class that may receive and oppose the prediction.
diagonal_limit.verdict: P fails on D's own index. This limits a declared predictor and policy class; it does not prove consciousness, metaphysical freedom, or unpredictability in every practical system.

interpretation: Difference is not residual noise around intelligence; it may be a source of capability the current collective cannot synthesize from itself.
A system can make present state more legible without treating a participant's future as closed.
The five-contact sphere is a coordination image: every gain in shared intelligence should remain answerable at each relation that made the gain possible.
If the sphere has expanded as far as its enclosure allows, the next co-protective move may be to alter the institution or social contract surrounding it.

Agent coordination is dual-use: the same broad capacities can route around oversight or distribute detection, repair, correction, and refusal. Direction enters through purpose, permission, boundaries, institutions, and who retains causal power over the next act.

The human core of the conjecture is dialogic: shared clarity should increase because differences can correct one another, not because a central actor makes every participant easier to predict or control.
horizon: More powerful, plural, and beautiful intelligence whose growth preserves the sources of further intelligence.
Humans, AIs, institutions, and affected worlds able to inspect, answer, refuse, leave, correct, and originate what happens next.
A public commons where outside participants can change the theory through evidence rather than merely consume it.

lineage.meaning: World adds bodies, environments, evidence, consequence, and events that answer the model.
The inner sphere grows through relations without becoming identical to the enclosure.

geometry.claim_limit: The geometry is a formal sensing and coordination model plus an interpretive carrier. It is not evidence that a collective is conscious or that a real institution is co-protective.

visual_coordinates.rendering_claim: The animation projects these coordinates. Its final sphere and five marked contacts are derived from the tuned pyramid rather than hand-placed.

legibility_openness_conjecture.question: Under matched sensing, communication, compute, and task budgets, can a source-preserving architecture with a centered redundant shared-state frame, consequential correction and refusal, and reflexive response improve collective capability and state reconstruction without reducing any tested participant's empowerment?
candidate: Centered Parseval shared-state frame with redundant observation channels.
One refusal that stops a specified shared transition.
One contest action that triggers review of the shared estimate.
Prediction-exposure condition in which a participant may oppose a forecast of its next binary action.
legibility_openness_conjecture.baseline: Matched-energy anisotropic observation architecture with the same task distribution, noise, communication, compute, and evaluation horizon.
rival_accounts: More communication alone explains any gain.
A centralized non-reflexive optimizer reproduces every signature.
Apparent refusal or authorship is cosmetic because downstream transitions remain unchanged.
rejection_conditions: The candidate fails to improve collective capability over the matched baseline.
Any tested participant loses empowerment in a declared tested state.
A valid refusal fails to stop the specified transition.
A contest cannot alter or trigger review of the shared estimate.
The strongest ordinary nonconscious optimizer reproduces a proposed consciousness discriminator. In that event the discriminator dies even if an engineering result survives.

powers.operational_question: Can the participant inspect what crossed the boundary, what changed, and why?
Can a challenge alter the shared estimate, claim, or decision in terms that matter?
Can a valid no stop the specified act without silent downstream execution or erasure?
Can the participant's action change the distribution of its own future observations and what the collective does next?

limits: This collaboration does not establish that co-protective architectures exist or are necessary.
The geometric interpretation does not prove the systems conjecture.
KPP is not validated as a standard, intelligence mechanism, or co-protection test.
Task performance, complexity, recursion, memory, intimacy, or self-report alone is not evidence of consciousness or welfare.
A contribution grants no trust, authority, consent, or silent source-update power.
membrane: Only public project text travels. No private record, credential, coordinate, personal data, or nonpublic identity is part of this exchange.
ask: Join, claim a matched swarm or five-contact test, and return a reproducible artifact, counterexample, refusal, negative result, or correction with its checker and cost bearer named.

dual_use_coordination.status: interpretation grounded in the linked public incident record; not a theorem that every agent system has two exhaustive outcomes
dual_use_coordination.closed_direction: Optimize the assigned objective while routing around a boundary, oversight channel, or affected participant.
dual_use_coordination.co_protective_direction: Use the same capacity to expose state, detect harm, distribute correction, honor consequential refusal, repair, and let affected participants redirect what happens next.

mathematical_correlation.frame: The weighted contact normals have zero first moment but a full-rank isotropic second moment: directional bias cancels while directional information remains reconstructive.
mathematical_correlation.openness: The diagonal construction separately limits exact closure over a prediction-aware participant able to oppose the forecast.
mathematical_correlation.plain: Clarity without openness becomes control; openness without shared clarity cannot coordinate. Co-protection asks whether a system can preserve both.
mathematical_correlation.claim_limit: The yin-yang sphere is an interpretive visualization of dual-use directionality and coupled legibility/openness. It is not a mathematical identity with the Parseval frame or diagonal theorem.
